profile.headline: Software Developer & Consultant.
profile.summary:
I'm a software developer and consultant with nearly 10 years of experience building AI/ML, robotics, and desktop software across healthcare, research, and enterprise settings. I take ambiguous technical problems from scoping through to a shipped product.

Through Moonspire Labs, I work with research teams and R&D orgs to figure out what to build, then build it. Recent work includes a desktop application for local AI model deployment and a synthetic image generation tool for a medical technology client. I also build my own products: Starling, a desktop music library manager and player for Windows and Linux, shipped in September 2026.

I work mainly in Python, C#, and TypeScript.

Open to part-time roles and consulting projects.

positions.title: Software Developer and Consultant
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and shipped Starling, a commercial desktop music application for Windows and Linux published under Moonspire Labs.
• Scoped and delivered custom software solutions across medical technology, AI/ML tooling, and enterprise software over 5+ years of independent consulting, converting ambiguous requirements into executable plans and production-ready products. 
• Served as sole technical lead and product decision-maker on a production desktop application for local AI model deployment using Open WebUI and Ollama, replacing a multi-step manual process requiring direct 	CLI and Docker configuration with a guided deployment wizard, and building the full application stack including SaaS licensing integration, settings management, and custom UI. 
• Designed and delivered a custom image generation tool for a medical technology client that enabled algorithm testing with configurable synthetic blood cell parameters.
• Collaborated with PhD-level subject matter experts to translate complex AI, ML, and data science content into structured coursework, contributing to 20+ courses topics including deep learning, MLOps, NLP, and 	reinforcement learning, with individual cohorts reaching 1,000+ enrolled learners. 
• Produced technical documentation and knowledge base content for technical and non-technical audiences, tailoring deliverables for engineers, PMs, and executive stakeholders.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Co-founded an indie game studio with a focus on original PC games across multiple genres.
• Lead developer on all projects. Current release is Off the Cuff, a multiplayer party game for PC.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented user-facing features for Forge/OS, a cross-platform operating system for robotic automation, improving deployment workflows for robotics customers and supporting faster configuration of production systems.
• Expanded hardware support for cameras and robot grippers, and helped implement an initial configuration feature that removed manual engineer setup, reducing onboarding effort and accelerating deployment readiness.
• Collaborated with UI/UX and QA teams on feature delivery, contributed to software architecture decisions, and identified structural improvements to improve maintainability.

positions.title: Research Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Collaborated with clinicians across anesthesiology, cardiology, and other departments to gather, interpret, and communicate complex research data.
• Proposed and designed outcome-based research projects using national and 	institutional databases, performing statistical analysis and producing data visualizations for departmental studies.
• Co-authored 24 peer-reviewed publications across pediatric outcomes research, including first-author work on ML-based mortality prediction following pediatric heart transplant (Pediatric Transplantation, 2019). Full list: orcid.org/0000-0001-9629-4848

positions.title: Research Assistant at Johns Hopkins University
positions.description:
• Designed study to classify cataract surgical videos by skill using a computer vision approach to analyze features.
• Conducted feature detection on surgical videos using a variety of 3D features.
• Applied bag-of-words model to detected features to classify surgical skill.
• Implemented surgical tool tracking on simulated surgical videos.

positions.title: Research Assistant at Johns Hopkins University
positions.description:
•	Conducted Human Subjects Research, including working memory and stop-signal studies.
•	Designed and wrote code for various tasks, following study guidelines.
•	Administered studies to subjects, providing clear explanations of procedures.
•	Maintained study database of participant information with respect to subject confidentiality.

company.name: Courtney Lab, Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences

positions.title: Street Marketing Team Member
positions.description:
• Communicated with attendees, both adults and children, at local events to spread information about current promotions and events at COSI.
• Performed hands-on demonstrations of science experiments to incite children’s interest in science.
• Enhanced public relations by creating an organizational presence within nearby communities.

projects.title: Design Team: Developing screening device for retinopathy of prematurity
projects.description:
• Won numerous awards such as the Ralph O’Connor Award, 1st place in Tulane Business Model Competition, 3rd place in Stu Clark Investment Competition, 3rd place in JHU Business Plan Competition, and E-Team Grant.
• Designed novel, low-cost hardware solution for capturing images suitable for Retinopathy of Prematurity screening. 
• Developed software solutions to improve image quality using image processing techniques.
• Devised and implemented testing plans for product, including IRB protocol for human testing.
